Q00100_SagaOfTheMaestro/0-06.htm.text: Chief Golem Craftsman Telson: Welcome back! Well, Master Tobald came by a few days ago and was talking about you! He said that you'd be coming by today, and here you are! How strange! Did you really finish the pilgrimage of tablets? You finished before Tobald! That's incredible!
